title: Non-uniqueness of global-in-time admissible weak solutions to the isentropic compressible Euler equations for a dense set of initial data
summary: In recent years, the technique of convex integration has demonstrated that for some initial data (also referred to as 'wild initial data'), many PDE models of mathematical fluid mechanics allow for a multitude of admissible (weak) solutions. This paper is concerned with the question regarding how large the set of such wild initial data is for the isentropic Euler equations. We prove that wild initial data form a dense set in $L^r$ for any $r \in [1,\infty)$.
